author: CtrlAltDel__
body:
Hello Avicus Staff, I am xCtrlAltDelx, and I am creating a ban appeal.

A long time ago, my friends and I used to play on this server all the time. Slowly, we abandoned it for a different server. After probably about a year, my friends and I joined Avicus again, alas, I was banned? I was banned for fly hacking which I completely deny. I've never used a hacked client before, so I was baffled to see this error message on my screen. 

I think I should be unbanned because I've found that this was a false ban. After lots of searching and frustration, I found out that my Minecraft account was hacked and was put on an alt generator. These hackers got me banned from some of my favorite servers, including this one. As devastating as it is, I started to write appeals for some of them. My brother contacted a staff in game about the situation, but I was shooed to make an appeal, so here I am. 

Thanks for reading my appeal and I hope all fares well and a good decision is made.
     Thanks,
          xCtrlAltDelx
